data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Hieronymos, meaning 'hieros' (sacred) and 'eranos' (reward), Jerrome translates to 'exalted by God'. This name was popular among early Christians and has been passed down through the centuries as a symbol of devotion and faith. The name Jerrome carries the meaning “Exalted by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jerrome usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
